summary: Mobile-only frontend test of new Account overlay feature (Ananta.AI). Owner login via preview token → Cockpit → tapped Ananta logo (testID=account-logo-btn) → Account modal opened, all required testIDs rendered correctly, real email populated, password properly masked with bullet dots, close and logout flows work as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: account.tsx is clean and well-scoped (~280 lines). Uses StyleSheet.create, testIDs on all interactive/informational elements, all text wrapped in <Text>, safe-area handled via useSafeAreaInsets, and modal presentation registered correctly in _layout.tsx.
Password masking uses \u2022 x 10 (real password never rendered) — confirmed in DOM inspection.
Logout flow calls auth.logout() then router.replace('/login'); RootNav also enforces redirect via useEffect on isOwner change — safe double-guard.

Minor (non-blocking): profile-header row is a Pressable with a chevron but no onPress; harmless for this sprint since rows are visual placeholders. Consider adding onPress={()=>{}} or removing the chevron if it's intentional for later sprints.
test_credentials: owner@ananta.ai / aZKtwzAqI0SzlwFE6TRqw8aH (preview) — verified via POST /api/auth/login, token stored in localStorage as ananta_owner_token
context_for_next_testing_agent: Account overlay (modal route /account) is fully wired. All acceptance criteria for the sprint verified on mobile Expo web preview at mobile viewport 390x844. Tested: (1) Cockpit renders account-logo-btn, (2) tap opens modal, (3) profile-header + account-email render owner email, (4) account-cred-email = real email, account-cred-password = 10 bullet dots (NOT real password), (5) feature rows: exchange/referrals/offers/earn/tax all present, (6) setting rows: payments/notifications/security all present, (7) invite banner present, (8) close-btn dismisses back to Cockpit, (9) logout-btn clears token from localStorage and navigates to /login. No red screen, no console errors related to the feature (only benign expo-notifications and pointerEvents deprecation warnings from unrelated deps).
